entries.headline: Novavax XFG COVID-19 vaccine joins public programme from October 19 for ages 12+
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: Public programme (公費): eligible people aged 12+ can now choose Novavax (Nuvaxovid) alongside Moderna, and Taiwan CDC says it plans additional Novavax doses. Rollout coverage across several outlets was neutral and factual.
entries.headline_zh: Novavax XFG COVID-19疫苗10月19日起納入公費，12歲以上適用
entries.why_zh: 公費：符合資格的12歲以上民眾現可選擇Novavax（Nuvaxovid）或Moderna，疾管署表示計畫增購Novavax疫苗。多家媒體對開打的報導中性、以事實為主。

entries.headline: Taiwan CDC rebuts viral claim of a US military ban on Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine
entries.zh: 疾管署澄清網傳「十月十四日突發消息：五角大廈已在全美軍範圍內禁止採購和接種莫德納Moderna的mRNA流感疫苗」，為錯誤訊息並非事實，請民眾勿信勿轉傳
entries.why: The CDC says the vaccine is not covered only because the US CDC has not yet recommended it; the claim does not concern a product in Taiwan's programme. Some headlines ('Moderna vaccine in trouble?') blur it with Moderna's COVID-19 vaccine, which is in the public programme.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署駁斥美軍禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗的網傳說法
entries.why_zh: 疾管署表示，該疫苗未獲給付僅因美國CDC尚未建議使用；此說法與台灣接種計畫中的產品無關。部分標題（「Moderna疫苗出包？」）將其與已納入公費的Moderna COVID-19疫苗混為一談。

entries.headline: Flu severity stays high: 44 weekly deaths, H1N1 at 92.7%; public antivirals extended
entries.why: Outlets report 159 new severe cases, 44 deaths and 123,000 visits in a week, Nantou reports 17 flu and COVID-19 deaths this year, and the CDC extended expanded public antiviral eligibility to November 15. This keeps urgency high for the public programme (公費).
entries.headline_zh: 流感疫情仍嚴峻：單週44人死亡，H1N1占92.7%；公費抗病毒藥物延長
entries.why_zh: 媒體報導單週新增159例重症、44人死亡、12.3萬就診人次；南投今年累計17例流感及COVID-19死亡；疾管署將擴大公費抗病毒藥物使用對象延長至11月15日。公費接種的急迫性持續居高。

entries.headline: Public flu shots reach 3.24 million, up 9.5%; Kaohsiung opens to 50+ November 2
entries.why: Public programme (公費): reports put Kaohsiung flu uptake up 13.6% and COVID-19 up 36.1% year on year, with second-stage expansion from November 2. Separately, Nantou will give 400 company-donated flu doses free to non-subsidised groups from November 2, a hybrid of public and outside-eligibility demand.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗接種達324萬劑，增加9.5%；高雄11月2日開放50歲以上
entries.why_zh: 公費：報導指高雄流感疫苗接種年增13.6%、COVID-19疫苗年增36.1%，第二階段自11月2日擴大開放。另南投自11月2日起將企業捐贈的400劑流感疫苗免費提供非公費對象，兼具公費與資格外需求性質。

entries.headline: Doctors link flu to heart attack and stroke risk in over-65s, discuss enhanced vaccines
entries.why: Multiple outlets carried physician commentary on immune ageing that mentions adjuvanted and high-dose flu vaccines, and one explainer sets out public versus self-paid options. Funding is mostly not stated, so this touches both arenas without clear self-pay detail.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感增加65歲以上長者心肌梗塞與中風風險，並討論加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體刊登醫師談免疫老化的評論，提及佐劑型與高劑量流感疫苗，另有一篇說明文比較公費與自費選項。多數未說明費用來源，因此兩個領域皆有涉及，但無明確自費細節。

entries.headline: Posts recycle COVID-19 vaccine harm claims; pregnancy post describes delaying RSV shot
entries.why: The most-engaged post claims long COVID is really vaccine injury, alongside blood-clot and relative-death claims; none name a brand or funding route. A separate pregnancy post describes an ER visit after Tdap and a decision to delay RSV, while noting the doctor said the symptoms were unrelated.
entries.headline_zh: 貼文重炒COVID-19疫苗傷害說法；孕婦貼文描述延後接種RSV疫苗
entries.why_zh: 互動最高的貼文聲稱長COVID-19其實是疫苗傷害，另有血栓及親屬死亡等說法；皆未提及品牌或費用來源。另一則孕婦貼文描述接種Tdap後掛急診並決定延後RSV疫苗，同時提到醫師表示症狀與疫苗無關。

watch.text: Second-stage public eligibility opens; Kaohsiung extends to adults 50+ and Nantou starts donated free doses for non-subsidised groups.
watch.text_zh: 第二階段公費對象開放；高雄擴及50歲以上成人，南投開始為非公費對象提供捐贈免費疫苗。

watch.text: Expanded public flu antiviral eligibility expires; watch whether the CDC extends it again given a still-active season.
watch.text_zh: 擴大公費流感抗病毒藥物使用對象到期；觀察疾管署是否因疫情仍活躍而再度延長。

watch.text: CDC and local bureaus (e.g. Keelung) push pre-holiday vaccination; watch uptake figures and any Novavax supply top-up announcements.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署與地方衛生局（如基隆）呼籲連假前接種；關注接種數據及Novavax補貨公告。

qa.q: Is the Moderna 'US ban' rumour affecting COVID-19 vaccine confidence?
qa.a: The CDC's rebuttal is about an mRNA flu vaccine not yet recommended in the US, but several outlets headlined it as 'Moderna vaccine in trouble?'. Social posts in today's sample do not reference the rumour directly; the COVID-19 safety posts are generic and brand-free.
qa.q_zh: Moderna「美國禁用」謠言是否影響COVID-19疫苗信心？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署澄清的是美國尚未建議的mRNA流感疫苗，但多家媒體以「Moderna疫苗出包？」為標題。今日樣本中的社群貼文未直接提及此謠言；COVID-19安全性貼文皆屬泛論，未提品牌。

qa.q: How is the Novavax public rollout being covered?
qa.a: Neutrally: outlets report it is available from October 19 and that eligible people aged 12+ can choose a brand, and the CDC says it plans extra Novavax doses. No social posts about Novavax appear in today's sample.
qa.q_zh: Novavax公費開打的報導情況如何？
qa.a_zh: 報導中性：媒體指自10月19日起提供，符合資格的12歲以上民眾可選擇廠牌，疾管署表示計畫增購Novavax。今日樣本中無Novavax相關社群貼文。

qa.q: Is there any self-pay (自費) signal for enhanced flu, RSV or Tdap?
qa.a: Very thin. One explainer mentions self-paid options alongside adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines, and Nantou's donated doses target people outside public eligibility; there is no price or clinic-stock reporting, and RSV/Tdap appear only in individual social posts.
qa.q_zh: 加強型流感疫苗、RSV或Tdap是否有自費相關訊號？
qa.a_zh: 非常少。一篇說明文在介紹佐劑型與高劑量疫苗時提及自費選項，南投捐贈疫苗則針對公費資格以外民眾；無價格或診所庫存報導，RSV/Tdap僅見於個別社群貼文。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: Formally adds Novavax as a public COVID-19 option from October 19 and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, shaping supply expectations for the rest of the season.
policy_notes.why_zh: 正式將Novavax自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，並釋出增購流感疫苗與Novavax的訊號，影響本季後續供應預期。

policy_notes.why: The pre-holiday call reports rising uptake, reiterates Novavax as an option and keeps health coins as the main incentive lever for the public programme.
policy_notes.why_zh: 連假前呼籲說明接種率上升，重申Novavax為選項之一，並維持健康幣作為公費接種的主要誘因。

policy_notes.why: The public-facing version of the antiviral extension notes antivirals are not covered by National Health Insurance, underlining the cost framing around flu illness.
policy_notes.why_zh: 抗病毒藥物延長措施的民眾版說明指出，抗病毒藥物不在健保給付範圍，凸顯流感患病的費用框架。

policy_notes.why: The letter to physicians extending public antiviral use to November 15 confirms the CDC still sees an active flu season, sustaining urgency around vaccination.
policy_notes.why_zh: 致醫師函將公費抗病毒藥物使用延長至11月15日，顯示疾管署仍認為流感疫情活躍，維持接種急迫性。

policy_notes.why: An official rebuttal of a fast-spreading mRNA rumour that gives companies and partners a citable reference if the claim resurfaces or gets conflated with COVID-19 vaccines.
policy_notes.why_zh: 官方對迅速擴散的mRNA謠言提出澄清，若說法再起或與COVID-19疫苗混淆，企業與合作夥伴可加以引用。

misinfo.claim: Long COVID does not exist and is actually COVID-19 vaccine injury
misinfo.note: Highest-engagement post in the sample; track spread and keep authoritative long-COVID and safety-monitoring references ready for partners, without direct public rebuttal by companies.
misinfo.claim_zh: 長COVID-19不存在，其實是COVID-19疫苗傷害
misinfo.note_zh: 樣本中互動最高的貼文；追蹤擴散情形，備妥長COVID-19與安全性監測的權威資料供合作夥伴參考，企業不宜直接公開反駁。

misinfo.claim: The US military banned Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine
misinfo.note: Taiwan CDC has already debunked it; align any stakeholder queries with the CDC clarification and watch for conflation with COVID-19 vaccines in the public programme.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美軍禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已澄清；利害關係人詢問時依疾管署說明回應，並留意是否與公費COVID-19疫苗混淆。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines are dangerous, carry a black box warning and caused relatives' deaths or illness
misinfo.note: Low-engagement anecdotal posts; monitor for any brand-specific turn and keep pharmacovigilance facts available for media enquiries.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗很危險、有黑框警語，並造成親屬死亡或患病
misinfo.note_zh: 低互動的個人經驗貼文；監測是否轉向特定品牌，並備妥藥物安全監視資料以回應媒體詢問。

misinfo.claim: Blood clots did not exist before COVID-19 vaccines
misinfo.note: Isolated claim alongside a personal clot story; no response needed beyond monitoring.
misinfo.note_zh: 零星說法，伴隨個人血栓經驗；僅需持續監測。

misinfo.claim: Vaccine deaths and side effects have never been studied
misinfo.note: Appears in an otherwise pro-vaccine post; low reach, monitor only.
misinfo.claim_zh: 疫苗死亡與副作用從未被研究
misinfo.note_zh: 出現在整體支持疫苗的貼文中；觸及率低，僅需監測。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Little this week: RSV mentions fell from 35 to 13 and nothing named infant antibodies. The closest signals are a pregnant user who says the couple will delay an RSV shot after side effects from other vaccines, and a doctor's piece on RSV risk in older adults.
products.implication: No live issue for infant antibodies, but maternal posts show RSV decisions are being bundled with Tdap and flu experiences during pregnancy, which could shape how parents later weigh infant options.
products.action: Keep an evidence pack ready on infant RSV prevention options and timing, and keep monitoring maternal and parenting conversations rather than engaging publicly now.
products.signal_zh: 本週動態不多：RSV提及量由35降至13，無任何內容提及嬰兒抗體。最相關的訊號是一名孕婦表示因其他疫苗副作用，夫妻將延後接種RSV疫苗，以及一篇醫師談長者RSV風險的文章。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒抗體目前無實際議題，但孕婦貼文顯示RSV決策正與孕期Tdap及流感疫苗經驗綁在一起，可能影響家長日後評估嬰兒選項。
products.action_zh: 備妥嬰兒RSV預防選項與接種時機的實證資料，持續監測孕產與育兒討論，暫不公開介入。
who_zh: 婦產科醫師與孕產婦健康學會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), in the public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose mentions held at 13. Several outlets ran a physician's warning that flu sharply raises heart attack and stroke risk in people 65+, discussing adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines. One piece framed enhanced vaccines as a new option, an explainer covered public and self-paid choices, and a veterans home began public enhanced flu shots.
products.implication: Media interest in enhanced vaccines for older adults is steady and physician-led, but coverage that singles out prescription vaccines carries advertising-compliance sensitivity. The November 2 second stage may also bring questions about who can access the limited enhanced allocation.
products.action: Review any company-linked media or HCP engagement for compliance with prescription-medicine advertising rules. Prepare factual briefing materials on the enhanced-vaccine allocation and long-term care rollout for officials and facility operators ahead of November 2.
who: Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus
Long-term care and veterans home operators
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費提供長照機構65歲以上對象
products.signal_zh: 高劑量提及量維持13則。多家媒體刊出醫師警告流感大幅提高65歲以上者心肌梗塞與中風風險，並討論佐劑型與高劑量疫苗。一篇將加強型疫苗定位為新選項，一篇說明文介紹公費與自費選擇，一處榮家開始提供公費加強型流感疫苗。
products.implication_zh: 媒體對長者加強型疫苗的關注穩定且由醫師主導，但點名處方疫苗的報導涉及廣告合規敏感性。11月2日第二階段也可能引發誰能取得有限加強型疫苗配額的疑問。
products.action_zh: 檢視任何與公司相關的媒體或醫療人員互動是否符合處方藥廣告規範。於11月2日前為官員與機構業者準備加強型疫苗配額與長照接種的事實說明資料。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Thin: Tdap mentions dropped from 7 to 3. One pregnant user reports contractions and an ER visit after a pertussis shot, though her doctor said the symptoms were unrelated. Another user reports evening fever and headache after Tdap.
products.implication: No media or policy activity, but first-person maternal side-effect stories can circulate in parenting communities and feed broader hesitancy across pregnancy vaccines.
products.action: Monitor maternal-forum conversation and keep pharmacovigilance and safety-information channels to clinicians current, so obstetric providers can answer patient questions if posts spread.
products.sub_zh: 百日咳追加劑，含孕婦接種
products.signal_zh: 動態稀少：Tdap提及量由7降至3。一名孕婦表示接種百日咳疫苗後出現宮縮並掛急診，但醫師表示症狀與疫苗無關。另一名用戶表示接種Tdap後晚間發燒、頭痛。
products.implication_zh: 無媒體或政策動態，但孕婦第一人稱副作用經驗可能在育兒社群流傳，加劇對孕期疫苗的整體猶豫。
products.action_zh: 監測孕產論壇討論，並維持向醫師提供最新藥物安全監視與安全性資訊，以便貼文擴散時婦產科人員能回答病人疑問。
who_zh: 公司藥物安全監視團隊

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax as a publicly funded COVID-19 option from October 19 for eligible people aged 12+ and said it plans additional Novavax doses. Several outlets covered the launch, and CDC repeated the option in its pre-holiday appeal.
products.implication: Novavax now has visible public-programme status and media attention, so supply adequacy and clinic availability become the main exposure if demand outpaces doses.
products.action: Stay in close contact with Taiwan CDC on delivery schedules for the additional doses and on site-level availability information. Prepare a factual Q&A on eligibility and supply for officials and clinics.
who: Taiwan CDC procurement and immunisation units
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗，由Sanofi在台經銷
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19疫苗選項，供符合資格的12歲以上民眾接種，並表示計畫增購Novavax。多家媒體報導開打消息，疾管署連假前呼籲亦重申此選項。
products.implication_zh: Novavax已具明確公費地位並受媒體關注，若需求超過供應，供應是否充足與診所可及性將成主要風險。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署密切聯繫增購疫苗的交貨時程與各接種點供應資訊。為官員與診所準備資格與供應的事實問答。
who_zh: 疾管署採購與預防接種單位

issues.title: Second-stage expansion to adults 50+ tests supply and enhanced-vaccine access
issues.note: Kaohsiung confirms expansion to adults 50+ from November 2 after strong uptake. Expect questions about stock and about who can receive the limited enhanced doses.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段擴及50歲以上成人，考驗供應與加強型疫苗可及性
issues.note_zh: 高雄在接種踴躍後確認11月2日起擴及50歲以上成人。預期將出現庫存及誰能接種有限加強型疫苗的疑問。

issues.title: Fast-moving vaccine rumours amplified by media and Threads
issues.note: A single false Pentagon-ban claim produced dozens of correction stories within a day, and COVID-19 safety misinformation continues on Threads. Have rapid-response facts and spokespeople ready.
issues.title_zh: 媒體與Threads放大快速擴散的疫苗謠言
issues.note_zh: 單一國防部禁用假訊息一天內即引發數十則澄清報導，Threads上的COVID-19安全性錯誤訊息持續。應備妥快速回應資料與發言人。

issues.title: Scrutiny of vaccine procurement prices
issues.note: A PTT post alleging a COVID-19 vaccine procurement price drew a formal report from Medigen. Tender pricing could become a transparency issue for all suppliers.
issues.note_zh: PTT一則指稱COVID-19疫苗採購價格的貼文，引發高端疫苗正式檢舉。標案價格可能成為所有供應商的透明度議題。

self_pay.title: Enhanced vaccines appear in choice explainers, not in price or stock reporting
self_pay.note: An explainer walks readers through public eligibility and choices including adjuvanted, high-dose and self-paid options. No items report clinic stock levels or prices for enhanced vaccines this week.
self_pay.title_zh: 加強型疫苗出現在選擇說明文中，未見於價格或庫存報導
self_pay.note_zh: 一篇說明文介紹公費資格與選擇，包括佐劑型、高劑量及自費選項。本週無報導提及加強型疫苗的診所庫存或價格。

self_pay.title: Donated doses reach non-subsidised groups in Nantou
self_pay.note: A company donated 400 flu doses that Nantou will give free to non-subsidised groups from November 2. Locally, this covers some people who would otherwise pay out of pocket.
self_pay.title_zh: 南投捐贈疫苗提供非公費對象
self_pay.note_zh: 一家企業捐贈400劑流感疫苗，南投將自11月2日起免費提供非公費對象。在地方層面涵蓋了部分原需自費的民眾。

self_pay.title: Cost-of-illness stories frame private decisions
self_pay.note: Coverage of an unvaccinated 80-year-old's roughly NT$600,000 hospital bill after travel puts a price on skipping vaccination, a frame that may shape demand among travellers outside the eligible groups.
self_pay.title_zh: 疾病費用報導形塑自費決策
self_pay.note_zh: 未接種疫苗的80歲長者旅遊後住院花費約NT$600,000的報導，為不接種疫苗標上價格，此框架可能影響資格外旅客的需求。

self_pay.title: Nothing on self-pay RSV infant antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: Posts mention Tdap and RSV shots during pregnancy without saying how they were funded. No items address clinic availability or prices for these products.
self_pay.title_zh: 無自費RSV嬰兒抗體或Tdap相關內容
self_pay.note_zh: 貼文提及孕期接種Tdap與RSV疫苗，但未說明費用來源。無內容涉及這些產品的診所供應或價格。
